note: Every field the HTTP corpus comparison ignores, and why it cannot be equal across two runs. A field is listed only when its value is generated per run or names the installation, never to hide a behavioral difference. An entry with an "at" names the key of the object that holds the field, so the field is ignored only there; a bare entry applies at every depth. The comparison asserts the field is present and, unless the recording holds null, carries the recorded type; every other field, frame, and body is compared exactly.

fields.name: pid
fields.reason: the process id of whichever dashboard answered

fields.name: port
fields.reason: the private listener port each run picked

fields.name: self
fields.reason: the absolute URL of the request, which names the listener port each run picked
